A <br> just after <a> is kept as a hard line break in the label

```csharp title="C#"
using System;
using HtmlToMarkdown;

var result = HtmlToMarkdownConverter.Convert("Beta<a href=\"https://example.com\"><br>Alpha</a>", new ConversionOptions());
Console.WriteLine(result.Content);
```
